title: CPU Throttling — KServe InferenceService
description: Handles CPU throttling incidents on KServe InferenceService predictor pods. Common in production when model inference load exceeds CPU limits.
root_causes: CPU limits set too low for current inference load
Unexpected traffic spike — HPA not scaled yet
Model batch size too large for allocated CPU

remediation_steps.description: Increase CPU limits to 2x current value
Sync ArgoCD to ensure Git reflects the change
Check throttling metric dropped below 20% within 5 minutes

prevention: Set CPU requests = 50% of limits (avoid burstable QoS class issues)
Enable KServe HPA with CPU target 60%
Use Kyverno policy require-resource-limits to enforce minimum limits
escalation: If throttling persists after 2x limit increase, investigate model optimization or horizontal scaling
